scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Through the power
of holiness, may we
find peace, strength
and protection. Deliver
us from the forces of evil...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
愿神圣之力赐予我们和平、力量与庇护，让我们免受邪恶侵害...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Our world is in
need of people of
talent and conviction.
Please continue your
good works as an even
greater hero of holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
这个世界需要有才干、有信念的人。
愿你成为更伟大的神圣英雄，继续行善...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Would you like
to become a High Priest?

[High Priest]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
As a High Priest,
I hope you will guide
others upon the path
to holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
愿你身为神官，引领他人走上神圣之路...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
